data.question: Berapa persentase penduduk miskin di Nusa Tenggara Timur pada Maret 2025?

value.raw_question: Berapa persentase penduduk miskin di Nusa Tenggara Timur pada Maret 2025?

value.sql:
SELECT T1.nama AS wilayah, T1.periode, AVG(T2.nilai) * 100.0 AS persentase
FROM provinsi AS T1
INNER JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND T2.periode = :periode
  AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY T1.nama, T1.periode

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, periode, SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS total_penduduk
FROM nilai_indikator
INNER JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY total_penduduk DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    periode,
    SUM(nilai) AS total_nilai
FROM 
    nilai_indikator
JOIN 
    provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE 
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY 
    provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY 
    total_nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, 
       nilai_indikator.nilai AS nilai, 
       (SUM(CASE WHEN nilai_indikator.nilai <= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(nilai_indikator.nilai)) AS persentase_miskin
FROM provinsi
INNER JOIN nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.nama
ORDER BY nilai DESC;

SELECT
  provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
  periode,
  SUM(nilai) AS total_nilai
FROM
  nilai_indikator
JOIN
  provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE
  nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
  provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY
  total_nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    periode,
    SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) * 100 / SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) OVER (PARTITION BY periode) AS persentase_miskin
FROM
    provinsi
JOIN
    nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
    periode, provinsi.kode
ORDER BY
    periode DESC;

SELECT 
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    periode,
    SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS total_nilai,
    AVG(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS avg_nilai
FROM 
    nilai_indikator
INNER JOIN 
    provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE 
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY 
    provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY 
    total_nilai DESC
LIMIT :top_n;
